label: sparse: late original / <DEL> steps of sequences starting with c, 1 or 2 (no precise trigger)
explanation: Very sparse, weak feature (0.03% of steps, max 0.27). It only fires at t>=4, never past recall_idx 1: about half its mass is on original steps 4-8, 39% on <DEL>, and 10% on the first copy output. 86% of its mass falls in sequences whose first token is c, 1 or 2 (lift 6-13x). Prefixes rich in h/x/y/s/g raise the rate (e.g. 1 h h x ..., c 0 h ...), but no conjunction I tested reaches useful precision. The context predicate gets dev recall 0.85 at precision 0.007, and the best refinement (>=2 of h/x/y/s/g seen) gets F1 only about 0.09. It looks like a distributed hidden-state direction rather than one readable trigger. It does not fire at t<4, on later copy steps, or once copying has gone wrong.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=c (+6.26), orig0=1 (+5.25), orig0=2 (+5.14), orig2=h (+4.35), orig1=h (+3.36), orig0=q (+3.33). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.71), correct=1 (-5.45), t=3 (-4.67), prev3_tok=- (-4.50).
